newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom to brief media on merger report.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom to brief media on merger report.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co Ltd said it would hold a news conference at 10.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) on Wednesday on a newspaper report about a possible merger with International Telecom Japan Inc (ITJ).
Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that Japan Telecom, a domestic long-distance telecommunications carrier, and ITJ plan to merge later this year.
The terms of the merger have not yet been established, but it is likely to be a stock-for-stock merger of about five ITJ stocks for one Japan Telecom share, the newspaper said.
ITJ, meanwhile, said that the company plans to issue a statement on Wednesday morning on the reported merger with Japan Telecom.

"We will issue a statement after confirming the facts," an ITJ spokeswoman told Reuters. "We have been in talks with Japan Telecom and other telecom firms, but we can not confirm if any specific plan for a tie-up or a merger has been decided with any particular company."
The Nihon Keizai said the firms decided on the merger in order to better compete against Japan's giant domestic carrier Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT).

Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD), Japan's other large carrier specialising in international telecommunications, may strike up an alliance with the two companies once further deregulation takes place in Japan's telecommunications industry, the paper said.
